properties.name: Project EnergyConnect Stage 2
properties.capacity_note: +650 MW NSW-SA and +100 MW VIC-SA (both directions). REZ limits: Riverland S2 +800 MW, South West NSW N5 +800 MW.
properties.description: Second 330 kV circuit Bundey-Buronga; new 330 kV double circuit Buronga-Dinawan; new 500 kV double circuit Dinawan-Wagga Wagga (operated at 330 kV); new Dinawan 330 kV switching station; 4 x 200 MVA phase-shifting transformers and 2 x 330/220 kV transformers at Buronga; synchronous condensers at Buronga and Dinawan. Stage 1 (Robertstown-Bundey-Buronga, 150 MW) was completed in late 2024.
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: Bundey, Dinawan. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: HumeLink
properties.capacity_note: +2,200 MW SNSW-CNSW (both directions). REZ: N6 + N7 +2,200 MW; South West NSW N5 +400 MW (limited by Wagga-Gugaa conductor).
properties.description: New Gugaa 500/330 kV substation; 500 kV double circuit Gugaa-Wagga Wagga (operated at 330 kV initially); three new 500 kV circuits Maragle-Bannaby, Maragle-Gugaa and Gugaa-Bannaby, meeting at a Y-point near Wondalga; 3 x 1,500 MVA transformers at Maragle and 2 x 1,500 MVA at Gugaa. Connects Snowy 2.0 and Project EnergyConnect to Bannaby.
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: Gugaa, Maragle, Wondalga. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Hunter-Central Coast REZ Network Infrastructure Project
properties.capacity_note: +600 MW modelled (1,000 MW intended network capacity; supports up to 1,800 MW of projects). Upstream limit from Muswellbrook 330 kV: 400 MW.
properties.description: Ausgrid 132 kV sub-transmission upgrades in three portions: Upper Hunter protection upgrades for two-way flow; new Sandy Creek 132 kV switching station at Muswellbrook and a new Singleton-Kurri 132 kV link; new Antiene 132 kV switching station on the north-east bank of Lake Liddell with a new Antiene-Kurri line. Network normally open, supplying both CNSW and Sydney-Newcastle-Wollongong.
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: Antiene. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Central-West Orana REZ Network Infrastructure Project
properties.capacity_note: +4,500 MW (initial stage of 6,000 MW intended). 7.7 GW of access rights awarded.
properties.description: New Merotherie 500/330 kV substation (4 x 1,500 MVA); new Elong Elong 330 kV and Barigan Creek 500 kV switching stations; two 500 kV double circuits Barigan Creek-Merotherie; two 500 kV double circuits Merotherie-Elong Elong (operated at 330 kV); 7 x 250 MVAr synchronous condensers; extra 330 kV circuits Bayswater-Liddell and Mt Piper-Wallerawang. Construction began June 2025. Above 3 GW the REZ needs the Hunter Transmission Project (Sydney Ring North).
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: Barigan Creek, Elong Elong, Merotherie. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Western Renewables Link (WRL)
properties.capacity_note: +695 MW MEL-WNV (both directions); Central Highlands REZ +310 MW. Unlocks ~1,460 MW of renewables.
properties.description: New 500 kV double circuit Sydenham-Bulgana; new 500 kV switchyard at Bulgana with 2 x 1,000 MVA 500/220 kV transformers; Ballarat-Moorabool No. 2 220 kV line cut into Elaine. Route follows the VicGrid published corridor.

properties.name: Project Marinus Stage 1 - Marinus Link HVDC
properties.capacity_note: 750 MW HVDC monopole each way (combined with Basslink: VIC->TAS 978 MW, TAS->VIC 1,344 MW).
properties.description: A 750 MW monopole HVDC link from a converter station in the Burnie area (Heybridge) to a converter station in the Hazelwood area, with a 500 kV connection at Hazelwood. Route = Marinus Link EIS/EES assessed route (subsea to Waratah Bay, then underground).

properties.name: Project Marinus Stage 1 - North West Transmission Developments
properties.capacity_note: Tasmanian 220 kV backbone for Marinus Link Stage 1.
properties.description: New 220 kV switching station at Heybridge; new 220 kV double circuit Sheffield-Heybridge-Burnie; new 220 kV double circuit Palmerston-Sheffield replacing the existing single circuit; existing Sheffield-Burnie 220 kV line decommissioned.
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: Heybridge. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: CopperString (Eastern Link)
properties.capacity_note: Hughenden Hub (Q2) +1,400 MW (to ~2,100 MW).
properties.description: New NQ 330/275 kV substation south of Townsville (2 x 1,500 MVA), cut into Strathmore-Ross 275 kV; new 330 kV double circuit to a new Hughenden 330 kV substation via a mid-point substation. Only the Townsville-Hughenden section is modelled in the 2026 ISP; QIC is beginning work on the Western Link to Mount Isa.
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: Hughenden, NQ 330. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: New England REZ Network Infrastructure Project
properties.capacity_note: +6,000 MW CNSW-NNSW (both directions); 8,000 MW intended REZ network capacity.
properties.description: New 500 kV double circuits Bayswater (South)-Central A-Central B; new Central A and Central B 500/330 kV hubs (Central B cut into Tamworth-Armidale 330 kV, with 4 x 340 MVA phase-shifting transformers); new 330 kV North and East hubs; Central A-North 500 kV built, 330 kV operated; Central B-East 330 kV double circuits. Hub sites shown here are indicative - final sites follow EnergyCo procurement.
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: NE Central A, NE Central B, NE East, NE North. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Gladstone Project
properties.capacity_note: Raises thermal capacity into the Gladstone Grid as coal retires.
properties.description: New Gladstone West 275 kV switching station; new high-capacity 275 kV double circuit Calvale-Calliope River (switched into Gladstone West); Larcom Creek double circuit switched into Gladstone West; third 275/132 kV transformer at Calliope River.
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: Gladstone West. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Western Victoria Reinforcement
properties.capacity_note: +800 MW MEL-WNV.
properties.description: Geelong-Keilor 220 kV lines cut into Deer Park; Keilor 500/220 kV transformers replaced with 1,000 MVA units; Deer Park-Keilor circuits normally open; minor plant replacements on the Geelong-Keilor lines.
properties.location_note: Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Sydney Ring North (Hunter Transmission Project)
properties.capacity_note: Up to +5,000 MW CNSW-SNW.
properties.description: New 500 kV double circuit Bayswater South-Olney; new switching stations at Bayswater South and Olney (near Eraring); 500 kV ties to Bayswater and Eraring; 2 x 1,500 MVA 500/330 kV transformers at Eraring. In NSW Government independent assessment; construction expected from late 2026 if approved.
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: Bayswater South, Olney. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Central to North Queensland Reinforcement (Stage 1)
properties.capacity_note: Raises NQ-CQ transfer (currently ~800 MW all seasons).
properties.description: String the second circuit on the Stanwell-Broadsound 275 kV line. PADR due by 25 June 2028.
properties.location_note: Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Sydney Ring South - 500 kV option
properties.capacity_note: Raises CNSW-SNW southern supply into Sydney.
properties.description: New South Creek switching station (later 500/330 kV with 3 x 1,500 MVA) cut into the Sydney 330 kV network; double circuit Bannaby-South Creek built to 500 kV on a new easement; rebuild/re-conductor ~7 km South Creek-Sydney West. Transgrid PADR prefers staging this with the power flow control option (PADR Option 6).
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: South Creek. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Sydney Ring South - power flow control option
properties.capacity_note: Better flow sharing between the northern and southern supply paths into Sydney.
properties.description: Power flow control devices on the 330 kV network supplying Sydney from the south. Site not yet published - shown at Bannaby. Requires the Hunter Transmission Project first.
properties.location_note: Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Tasmania REZ Expansion (Burnie-Hampshire Hills)
properties.capacity_note: North West Tasmania REZ (T2) +800 MW.
properties.description: New double circuit Burnie-Hampshire Hills 220 kV line. Alternative option: Waddamana 220/110 kV transformer and Waddamana-Palmerston conversion to 220 kV for the Central Highlands REZ (+555 MW, Dec 2030). PADR due by 25 June 2028.
properties.location_note: Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Switching Station near Wondalga
properties.capacity_note: Raises SNSW-CNSW transfer.
properties.description: New 500 kV switching station at the HumeLink Y-point near Wondalga connecting the three 500 kV circuits. PADR due by 30 April 2028.
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: Wondalga. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Gippsland Offshore Wind Transmission Project
properties.capacity_note: Connects Gippsland offshore wind (VIC targets 2 GW by 2032, 4 GW by 2035, 9 GW by 2040).
properties.description: Stage 1: 500 kV double-circuit radial line Loy Yang-Giffard. Stage 2 Phase 1: second 500 kV double circuit from a new terminal station near Woodside. Stage 2 Phase 2: Giffard-Woodside tie-in loop. Route follows the VicGrid draft preferred route.

properties.name: VNI West (Victoria - NSW Interconnector West)
properties.capacity_note: Raises VIC-NSW transfer; via Kerang (RIT-T option 5A).
properties.description: New 500 kV double circuit from near Bulgana to a new Tragowel terminal station (near Kerang, 2 x 1,000 MVA 500/220 kV) and on to Dinawan, with series compensation and dynamic reactive support. Connects to WRL at Bulgana. Victorian section follows the VicGrid corridor; NSW section drawn straight to Dinawan.
properties.location_note: Route: VicGrid corridor in Victoria (centreline); straight line in NSW. Approximate location for: Dinawan, Murray border. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: VNI West - South West NSW REZ component
properties.capacity_note: South West NSW REZ: third Dinawan transformer adds 1,800 MW.
properties.description: Upgrade the Dinawan-Wagga Wagga-Gugaa double circuit from 330 kV to 500 kV; Dinawan 500 kV switchyard with three 500/330 kV 1,500 MVA transformers. The ISP finds it more efficient to deliver this with VNI West as one project.
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: Dinawan, Gugaa. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Brisbane Area 275 kV Reinforcement
properties.capacity_note: Raises SQ-CQ transfer capability.
properties.description: New high-capacity 275 kV double circuit between Blackwall and a new Karana Downs substation; existing Blackwall, South Pine and Rocklea 275 kV circuits rearranged. Replaces Queensland SuperGrid South, which is no longer in the plan.
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: Karana Downs. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Central-West Orana REZ Expansion
properties.capacity_note: Takes CWO towards its 6,000 MW intended capacity.
properties.description: New Merotherie-B 500/330 kV substation (3 x 1,500 MVA) at least 2 km from Merotherie; 500 kV double circuit Merotherie-A to Merotherie-B; Elong Elong expanded to 500/330 kV (3 x 1,500 MVA).
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: Elong Elong, Merotherie. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Project Marinus Stage 2
properties.capacity_note: Second 750 MW HVDC (combined: VIC->TAS 1,728 MW, TAS->VIC 2,094 MW).
properties.description: A second 750 MW monopole HVDC link Burnie area-Hazelwood area (ML2 route); new Staverton 220 kV switching station; new 220 kV double circuit Staverton-Hampshire; Sheffield-Mersey Forth lines cut in at Staverton. Requires Stage 1 and the Tasmania REZ Expansion.
properties.location_note: Route: Marinus Link EIS/EES assessed route (ML2) for the HVDC. Approximate location for: Staverton. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Eastern Victoria Reinforcement
properties.capacity_note: Raises SEV-MEL transfer from Gippsland.
properties.description: Third 1,000 MVA 500/220 kV transformer at Rowville; later options add series impedance on the Hazelwood transformers or a second Cranbourne transformer.
properties.location_note: Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: QNI Connect
properties.capacity_note: +1,260 MW NSW->QLD, +1,700 MW QLD->NSW.
properties.description: New 330 kV double circuit from the New England North hub to Dumaresq, Bulli Creek and Braemar, with 330/275 kV transformers at Braemar. No longer actionable; proponents have stopped the PADR.
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: Dumaresq, NE North. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: South West to South East Queensland Reinforcement
properties.capacity_note: South West Queensland REZ export.
properties.description: Replace the 330/275 kV 1,300 MVA transformer at Middle Ridge with a 1,500 MVA unit, plus a generation run-back scheme in south-west Queensland.
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: Middle Ridge. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Central to North Queensland Reinforcement (Stage 2)
properties.capacity_note: Further NQ-CQ transfer.
properties.description: New high-capacity 275 kV double circuits Bouldercombe-Broadsound and Broadsound-Nebo, replacing the existing single circuits.
properties.location_note: Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Northern Transmission Project (NTx)
properties.capacity_note: Mid-North SA to Adelaide.
properties.description: New 275 kV double circuit Bundey to a new substation near Bolivar/Dry Creek tied into the metropolitan 275 kV network; 132 kV reconfiguration around Templers West. ElectraNet now advises 2031-32 earliest.
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: Bundey. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: Second Tasmania REZ Expansion (Waddamana-Palmerston)
properties.capacity_note: Central Highlands REZ (T3).
properties.description: Convert the Waddamana-Palmerston 110 kV line to 220 kV operation and install a 220/110 kV transformer at Waddamana.
properties.location_note: Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.

properties.name: South West Victoria Expansion
properties.capacity_note: Raises WNV-MEL transfer.
properties.description: New 500 kV double circuit Moorabool-Truganina and single circuit Truganina-Sydenham; new Truganina 500/220 kV substation; two 220 kV double circuits Truganina-Deer Park; rebuild the Deer Park-Keilor 220 kV lines.
properties.location_note: Approximate location for: Deer Park, Truganina. Route drawn substation to substation; not the surveyed alignment.
